name: Lady's day at the tower
summary: Lễ Vía Bà at Tháp Nhạn runs from the 20th through the 23rd of the third lunar month. The main day is the 21st. Groups of about 30 to 50 bring fruit and farm goods for Thiên Y A Na. The heritage page says Cham visitors come from Ninh Thuận and Bình Thuận, and that some groups hold hầu bóng. The solar dates move. Check on arrival. No fee was printed. The photograph is the tower lit after dark, not the rite.
when: 20th–23rd of the third lunar month. Main day the 21st. Solar dates: check on arrival.
